text: In the Penrose diagram of Minkowski spacetime, i⁰ is spatial infinity and i⁺ is future timelike infinity. The place where all outgoing radial light rays (null geodesics) end is:
explanation: The book labels 𝓘⁺ (future null infinity, 'scri-plus') as where outgoing null geodesics end, while 𝓘⁻ is where incoming null geodesics begin. Massive particles instead end at i⁺ (future timelike infinity) and spacelike geodesics end at i⁰ (spatial infinity); massive particles cannot reach 𝓘±.
